pyramiding_rule: Strict prohibition of secondary entries within 60 seconds or 1.5 ATR of a prior position to eliminate falling knife pyramiding.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Multi-timeframe momentum convergence (EMA 14/28 cross + RSI filter 40-60 neutral avoidance) required before order authorization.
profit_harvest_threshold: Trigger trailing stop lock-in immediately upon crossing +$12.00 unrealized profit to allow full extension toward the $15-$30+ target zone.
